title: Dxcufgb's Reminders
description: Keeps legendary actions, villain actions, lair actions, legendary resistances, when-hit traits and death triggers in the GM's chat at the right moments. Cards list each option with its cost and the points remaining; expand Use an Action for native dnd5e Use buttons that spend legendary points through the system pipeline. When a creature with a death-triggered feature (Undead Fortitude, Death Burst...) drops to 0 HP, the GM gets a card with a sound and a Use button (this replaces Dxcufgb's Death Trigger Alerts). Each world keeps its own editable Reminder list.
